description: This Scala source file defines a StatsdReporter class for reporting metrics to StatsD, including methods for reporting gauges, counters, histograms, meters, and timers, and manages socket communication with error handling.

classes.name: StatsdMetricType
classes.description: Object defining constants for StatsD metric types: counter, gauge, timer, set.

classes.name: StatsdReporter
classes.description: Class for reporting metrics to StatsD server, handling socket communication and formatting metrics.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Main method to send all metrics (gauges, counters, histograms, meters, timers) to StatsD via UDP socket.

methods.name: reportHistogram
methods.description: Send histogram metrics including count, max, mean, min, stddev, and percentiles.

methods.name: reportMetered
methods.description: Send meter metrics including count and rates.

methods.name: reportTimer
methods.description: Send timer metrics including max, mean, min, stddev, percentiles, and meter rates.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Send a formatted metric packet via UDP socket.

methods.name: fullName
methods.description: Construct full metric name with prefix and components.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitize metric name string by replacing whitespace with hyphens.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Format a value into a string with two decimal places if applicable.

methods.name: formatAny
methods.description: Convert various numeric types to formatted string, or return None.
